; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (bobj Ref)(y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (x Int)(j Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (x Int)(j Ref)(yy Int)(i Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((C (mk-C (x Int)(j Ref)(yy Int)(i Ref)(z Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  (lift-C (sel-C C))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-C ((this Ref)) C
  (sel-C (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-A this)
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-C this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.bobj: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!bobj ((this Ref)) Ref
  (bobj (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.x: ---

(define-fun A.x ((this Ref)) Int
  (ite (deref-is-A this) (x (deref-A this))
  (ite (deref-is-B this) (x (deref-B this))
  (x (deref-C this))))
)

(define-fun A!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-A this))
)

; --- getters for A.j: ---

(define-fun A!j ((this Ref)) Ref
  (j (deref-A this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class B:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for B.x: ---

(define-fun B!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-B this))
)

; --- getters for B.j: ---

(define-fun B!j ((this Ref)) Ref
  (j (deref-B this))
)

; --- getters for B.yy: ---

(define-fun B.yy ((this Ref)) Int
  (ite (deref-is-B this) (yy (deref-B this))
  (yy (deref-C this)))
)

; --- getters for B.i: ---

(define-fun B!i ((this Ref)) Ref
  (i (deref-B this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class C:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for C.x: ---

(define-fun C!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-C this))
)

; --- getters for C.j: ---

(define-fun C!j ((this Ref)) Ref
  (j (deref-C this))
)

; --- getters for C.i: ---

(define-fun C!i ((this Ref)) Ref
  (i (deref-C this))
)

; --- getters for C.z: ---

(define-fun C.z ((this Ref)) Int
  (z (deref-C this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class C:
; ------------------------

(define-fun C.foo ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (+ x 1)
)

(define-fun C!foo ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (+ x 1)
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-C (TopLevelDeclarations!bobj this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (C.z (TopLevelDeclarations!bobj this)) 1)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-A A)
(declare-const const-2-A A)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun A.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool

)

(assert (! (A.inv1 1) :named _xkassert2))
(assert (! (A.inv1 2) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun A.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (A!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (A.inv2 1) :named _xkassert4))
(assert (! (A.inv2 2) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun A.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (B.yy (A!j this)) 10)
)

(assert (! (A.inv3 1) :named _xkassert6))
(assert (! (A.inv3 2) :named _xkassert7))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-B B)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun B.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-B (B!j this))
)

(assert (! (B.inv1 3) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun B.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-A (B!i this))
)

(assert (! (B.inv2 3) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun B.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (B!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (B.inv3 3) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun B.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (B.yy (B!j this)) 10)
)

(assert (! (B.inv4 3) :named _xkassert11))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun B.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (A.x (B!i this)) 10)
)

(assert (! (B.inv5 3) :named _xkassert12))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class C:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-C C)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun C.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-B (C!j this))
)

(assert (! (C.inv1 4) :named _xkassert13))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun C.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-A (C!i this))
)

(assert (! (C.inv2 4) :named _xkassert14))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun C.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (C!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (C.inv3 4) :named _xkassert15))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun C.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (B.yy (C!j this)) 10)
)

(assert (! (C.inv4 4) :named _xkassert16))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun C.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (A.x (C!i this)) 10)
)

(assert (! (C.inv5 4) :named _xkassert17))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-A const-1-A))
        2 (lift-A const-2-A))
        3 (lift-B const-3-B))
        4 (lift-C const-4-C))
  )
)
